comment:purpose: The instance the `demo` command runs as. Its corpus is this package's OWN documentation, walked under the package directory rather than under a repository — so `demo` works for a reader who owns no vault, in a checkout and in an install alike.
comment:why-a-profile: The six documents below sit at the package root and are claimed by NO domainRule of the shipped `default` profile, so an ingest under that profile skips every one of them with `outside every declared ingest root`. A demo that reports an empty corpus as a success is exactly the failure class this repository exists to police, so the demo declares its own domain instead — data only, no TypeScript edit, the same way `hu-tax` onboards a vocabulary the shipped one never heard of.
comment:locations: It declares NO repoRoot, atomsDir or indexPath: those are FIXED by the command through src/paths.ts (`demoCorpusRoot`, `demoAtomsDir`, `demoIndexDir`), because they must follow the resolved data root of the machine the demo runs on rather than any path authored here.
name: demo
comment:types: `knowledge` alone. Types are CLOSED — `asType` relabels an unknown name at read time and `--type` validates against the shipped vocabulary — so this profile invents none.
